locus: St Damasus, Pope, Collect; normalized artifact physical lines 48-50; Lasance printed p. 855, IA leaf n853
rights_basis: This bounded artifact contains ten Latin prayers already printed in the public-domain Lasance New Roman Missal before the 1962 typical edition: three orations for Cyril of Alexandria, the Collects for Peter Canisius, Ephrem, John Eudes, and Damasus, and three orations for Sylvester the Abbot. The affirmative United States public-domain basis for the Lasance 1945 revised edition is failure to renew registrations A 110108 and A 192159, established at registration-number level in src/sources/inventories/lasance-new-roman-missal-rights-v1.toml. The target-edition comparison contributes no new prayer expression: it selects mechanical spelling, capitalization, punctuation, and unabbreviated standard conclusions within those preexisting formulas. Under 17 U.S.C. 103(b), copyright in a later compilation or revision does not extend to the preexisting material. No page image, layout, English translation, rubric, biography, appendix matter, or 1962-only formula is reproduced.
text:
Gregem tuum, Pastor aeterne, placatus intende: et per beatum Damasum
Summum Pontificem perpetua protectione custodi; quem totius Ecclesiae
praestitisti esse pastorem. Per Dominum.
